title: Toddler in Backyard, Banana Tree Rose Bushes - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
I took this from Sammy boys window with the camera Jack gave Harold. I didn't have it focused right. The tree is a banana tree & the bushes are rose bushes
262
description: A candid outdoor snapshot taken from a second-story window looking down into a sunny backyard. In the center lawn, a small toddler stands among newly planted rose bushes near a wooden fence line flanked by a tall banana tree. Handwritten notes on the reverse provide a sweet family narrative about a camera gifted from Jack to Harold, noting the slightly out-of-focus amateur framing.
